subject: maths
question: How much simple interest will ₹5,000 earn in 14 months at a 12% interest rate per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹5,000

Time (T) = 14 months = 14/12 years = 7/6 years

Rate of interest (R) = 12% per annum

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (₹5,000 × 12 × 7/6) / 100

⇒ SI = (₹5,000 × 12 × 7) / (6 × 100)

⇒ SI = (₹5,000 × 2 × 7) / 100

⇒ SI = (₹5,000 × 14) / 100

⇒ SI = ₹70,000 / 100

⇒ SI = ₹700

**∴ The simple interest earned is ₹700.**
